title: Johnson & Johnson Receives FDA Clearance for Expanded U.S. Ear, Nose and Throat (ENT) Indication for HARMONIC™ 1100 Shears
summary: •FDA clearance allows HARMONIC 1100 Shears to be used across a broader range of ENT procedures within the U.S. •Expanded indication supports use in both pediatric and adult patients, allowing ultrasonic surgical technology in a specialty where precision is critical.
body_markdown:
**NEW BRUNSWICK, N.J. – November 16, 2026** – Johnson & Johnson today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has cleared an expanded otorhinolaryngology, or ENT, indication for HARMONIC 1100 Shears. The indication enables use in ENT procedures involving pediatric and adult patients for the ligation and division of vessels, lymphatics and tissue bundles. This is the first Johnson & Johnson ultrasonic device with a 7 mm vessel sealing indication for ENT procedures and is designed to deliver minimal thermal spread,1-7 supporting the precise tissue management required in these types of procedures.


**Supporting ENT Procedures**


HARMONIC 1100 Shears is a sterile, single-patient-use advanced ultrasonic energy device for general dissection, vessel sealing, back-scoring, otomy creation, mesentery marching or meticulous tissue plane dissection. Its ergonomic handle, integrated handpiece and Advanced Hemostasis technology include dual energy-delivery buttons for focused dissection or coagulation.4


ENT procedures often require precise dissection and tissue preservation, particularly in pediatric patients and other anatomically sensitive structures. HARMONIC devices use heat to seal and divide vessels with minimal lateral thermal spread,1-7 and the curved, tapered blade of HARMONIC 1100 Shears mirrors a mechanical dissector,8-12* designed to enable precise access to tissue planes in the deep, tight spaces encountered during ENT procedures. 11,13†


**Evidence Supporting the Clearance**


The expanded indication was supported by real-world evidence from the Premier Healthcare Database showing low 30-day complication and hospital readmission rates when HARMONIC Shears were used across pediatric and adult ENT procedures, including neck dissection, glossectomy, laryngectomy, pharyngectomy, tonsillectomy, parathyroid, thyroidectomy and adenoidectomy. The addition of ENT indications further strengthens Johnson & Johnson MedTech’s surgical energy portfolio and commitment to supporting clinicians across a wider range of procedures.


“This FDA clearance marks an important step in expanding access to HARMONIC™ technology for ENT procedures showcasing Johnson & Johnson’s commitment to serving the specialty, which represents[approximately 5.5 million surgical procedures annually within the U.S](https://www.360researchreports.com/market-reports/surgical-ent-devices-market-201159)


. Supported by real-world evidence, the expanded indication reinforces our commitment to developing innovations that address the evolving needs of surgeons and the patients they serve,” said Sandeep Makkar, Worldwide President, Endomechanical and Energy, MedTech, Johnson & Johnson.
